messages.text: 你好，我想先对这篇论文有个整体了解。Hunyuan3D 2.0 到底提出了什么？请重点讲一下和我的目标相关的部分：我想从网上的公开照片生成可以用于 AR 的 3D assets，所以麻烦你从这个角度概括一下它的核心方法和输出结果。

messages.short_answer: Hunyuan3D 2.0 是一个从单张图像生成带纹理 3D 资产的两阶段系统：先用 Hunyuan3D-DiT 生成裸网格，再用 Hunyuan3D-Paint 合成纹理图。论文强调它能从单张图生成高分辨率、高保真的带纹理网格，这与你从公开照片生成 AR 资产的目标直接相关，但论文本身并未评估 AR 场景的需求。

sections.title: 两阶段的核心方法
sections.text: 论文把流程分成两步：先从输入图像生成裸网格（形状），再为该网格合成纹理图。作者认为这种设计能解耦形状与纹理的生成难度，并且纹理模块既可用于生成的网格，也可用于手工建模的网格。

sections.title: 形状与纹理模块各自做什么
sections.text: Hunyuan3D-DiT 以图像为条件生成裸网格，它基于 Hunyuan3D-ShapeVAE 学到的潜空间；Hunyuan3D-Paint 以生成网格的法线图和位置图等几何条件为输入，输出用于烘焙纹理的多视角图像。可以把它理解为：先定形，再根据几何信息上色。

sections.title: 对 AR 资产生成的可用性
sections.text: 对你的目标而言，它的输出形式（带纹理的网格）与 AR 资产的常见格式相近，而且可以接受单张图像作为输入，这可能适合作为从公开照片获取初始 3D 资产的基线或先验。不过论文的输入是通常经过去背景和居中处理的图像，而公开照片往往光照和视角杂乱，需要你额外考虑预处理和适配。

sections.title: 论文中与 AR 相关的线索
sections.text: 概述中提到，纹理模块的输入图像会先经过去光照（delighting）的预处理，并且 Hunyuan3D-Studio 提供低多边形风格化（Low-polygon Stylization）功能，可把密集网格简化为低面数网格。这两点对公开照片和 AR 设备的性能约束都有一定参考价值，但论文并未就 AR 场景做专门评估。

sources.text: 8 Conclusion In this report, we introduce an open-source 3D creation system—Hunyuan3D 2.0 —for generating textured meshes from images. We present Hunyuan3D-ShapeV AE, which is trained using a novel importance sampling method. This approach compresses each 3D object into a few latent tokens while minimizing reconstruction losses. Building on our V AE, we developed Hunyuan3D-DiT, an advanced diffusion transformer capable of generating visually appealing shapes that align precisely with input images. Besides, we introduce Hunyuan3D-Paint, another diffusion model designed to create textures for both our generated meshes and user-crafted meshes. With several innovative designs, our texture generation model, in conjunction with our shape generation model, can produce high-resolution, high-fidelity textured 3D assets from a single image. As we continue to make progress, we hope that Hunyuan3D 2.0 will serve as a robust baseline for large-scale 3D foundation models within the open-source community and facilitate future research endeavors.
quotes: With several innovative designs, our texture generation model, in conjunction with our shape generation model, can produce high-resolution, high-fidelity textured 3D assets from a single image.

sources.text: To this end, we presentHunyuan3D 2.0, a 3D asset creation system with two strong open-sourced 3D foundation models:Hunyuan3D-DiTfor generative shape creation andHunyuan3D-Paintfor generative texture synthesis. Hunyuan3D 2.0 features a two-stage generation pipeline, starting with the creation of a bare mesh, followed by the synthesis of a texture map for that mesh. This strategy is effective for decoupling the difficulties of shape and texture generation [ 34, 107, 46, 47] and also provides flexibility for texturing either generated or handcrafted meshes. With this architecture, our shape creation model – Hunyuan3D-DiT, is designed as a large-scale flow-based diffusion model. As a prerequisite, we first train an autoencoder – Hunyuan3D-ShapeV AE using advanced techniques such as mesh surface importance sampling and variational token length to capture fine-grained details on the meshes. Then, we build up a dual-single stream transformer [ 45] on the latent space of our V AE with the flow-matching [53, 24] objective.
quotes: Hunyuan3D 2.0 features a two-stage generation pipeline, starting with the creation of a bare mesh, followed by the synthesis of a texture map for that mesh.

sources.text: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation “Living out everyone’s imagination on creating and manipulating 3D assets.” —Hunyuan3D Team ∗ Abstract We present Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced large-scale 3D synthesis system for generating high-resolution textured 3D assets. This system includes two foundation components: a large-scale shape generation model – Hunyuan3D-DiT, and a largescale texture synthesis model – Hunyuan3D-Paint. The shape generative model, built on a scalable flow-based diffusion transformer, aims to create geometry that properly aligns with a given condition image, laying a solid foundation for downstream applications. The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes. Furthermore, we build Hunyuan3D-Studio – a versatile, user-friendly production platform that simplifies the re-creation process of 3D assets. It allows both professional and amateur users to manipulate or even animate their meshes efficiently.
quotes: The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes.

sources.text: The comparison shows the superiority of Hunyuan3D 2.0 in alignment between conditional images and generated meshes, generation of fine-grained details, and human preference ratings. 2 Hunyuan3D 2.0 Architecture In this section, we elaborate on the model architecture of Hunyuan3D 2.0, focusing on two main components: the shape generation model and the texture generation model. Fig. 2 illustrates the pipeline of Hunyuan3D 2.0 for creating a high-resolution textured 3D asset. Given an input image, Hunyuan3D-DiT initially generates a high-fidelity bare mesh via the shape generation model. This model comprises a Hunyuan3D-ShapeV AE and a Hunyuan3D-DiT, which will be discussed in Sec. 3. Subsequently, by leveraging strong geometric priors and the input image, we introduce Hunyuan3D- Paint as our texture generation model in Sec. 4. This model produces self-consistent multi-view outputs, which are used for baking high-definition texture maps.
quotes: This model produces self-consistent multi-view outputs, which are used for baking high-definition texture maps.

sources.text: These pages describe the Hunyuan3D-DiT shape generation transformer, which uses double- and single-stream blocks to let shape latent tokens and image condition tokens interact, with timestep-only modulation and no positional embedding on the latent sequence. Image conditioning uses DINOv2 Giant features at 518x518 with background removal and centering, and training follows a flow matching objective with an affine conditional optimal transport path and Euler ODE sampling at inference. The pages then introduce Hunyuan3D-Paint, a generative texture map synthesis pipeline with image delighting as pre-processing, a reference-net and multi-task attention for multi-view consistency, and a geometry-aware greedy viewpoint selection strategy using 8 to 12 views. Details of the multi-view synthesis and texture baking stages are only referenced, not fully described on these pages.

These pages describe the geometry and view conditioning of the Hunyuan3D-Paint texture synthesis pipeline, where canonical normal maps and canonical coordinate maps are encoded by a pre-trained VAE and concatenated with latent noise, and a learnable view embedding is added. They then cover texture baking, including a view dropout strategy that samples 6 of 44 pre-set viewpoints to enable dense-view inference, a pre-trained single-image super-resolution step applied per view, and a weighted-sum inpainting method for uncovered UV texels. The final section gives implementation details: training from the Stable Diffusion 2 v-model checkpoint on a self-collected 3D dataset under even white light, 512x512 resolution, 80,000 steps, batch size 48, and learning rate 5e-5. The pages close by noting the framework also supports text- or image-guided texture generation for arbitrary geometry.

These pages describe the Hunyuan3D-Studio platform, a toolset for the 3D production pipeline built on Hunyuan3D 2.0, aimed at both experts and novices. They cover three features: Sketch-to-3D, which converts sketches into detailed images and then into high-fidelity textured 3D assets, and Low-polygon Stylization, which reduces dense generated meshes to low-polygon meshes. The low-polygon module uses a traditional vertex-merging geometric method and then transfers texture via a KD-tree nearest-neighbour lookup and texture baking. The section also introduces a 3D character animation function that uses a Graph Neural Network to predict skeleton keypoints and skinning weights, followed by motion templates; the text is cut off before that section concludes. No quantitative results or limitations are stated on these pages.

sections.title: 第二阶段的三步流程
sections.text: 论文说纹理部分采用三阶段框架：预处理（输入图像去光照）、多视角图像合成（即 Hunyuan3D-Paint），以及基于密集多视角推理的纹理烘焙。论文还称 Hunyuan3D-Paint 是一个以网格为条件的多视角生成流程，加上预处理和把多视角图像烘焙为高分辨率纹理图的技术。

sections.title: 法线图与位置图是什么（通俗解释）
sections.text: 法线图记录网格表面每个点的朝向，位置图记录每个点在三维空间中的坐标。两者都由已生成的裸网格导出，因此可以告诉多视角生成模型物体的几何形状和视角下的可见结构，从而让纹理贴合形状。这是对一般概念的解释，并非论文原文。

sources.text: To achieve these objectives, we employ a three-stage framework, including a pre-processing stage (Sec. 4.1), a multi-view image synthesis stage (Sec. 4.2, Hunyuan3D-Paint), and a texture baking stage based on dense multi-view inference (Sec. 4.3). Other details related to model training and textand image-to-texture pipeline are provided in Sec. 4.4. Fig. 5 illustrates the complete pipeline of our texture map synthesis method. 4.1 Pre-processing Image Delighting Module.The reference image typically exhibits pronounced and varied illumination and shadow, whether collected by the user or generated by T2I models. Directly inputting such images into the multi-view generation framework can cause illumination and shadows to be baked into the texture maps. To address this issue, we leverage a delighting procedure on the input image via an image-to-image approach [6] before multi-view generation. Specifically, to train such an image delighting model, we collect a large-scale 3D dataset and render it under the illumination of a random HDRI environmental map and an even white light to form the corresponding pair-wise image data.
quotes: To address this issue, we leverage a delighting procedure on the input image via an image-to-image approach [6] before multi-view generation.

sources.text: Then, we build up a dual-single stream transformer [ 45] on the latent space of our V AE with the flow-matching [53, 24] objective. Our texture generation model – Hunyuan3D-Paint is made of a novel mesh-conditioned multi-view generation pipeline and a number of sophisticated techniques for preprocessing and baking multi-view images into high-resolution texture maps. We performed an in-depth comparison ofHunyuan3D 2.0 in relation to leading 3D generation models worldwide, including three commercial closed-source end-to-end products, an end-to-end opensourced model Trellis [101], and several separate models [9, 37, 99, 111, 55, 59] for shape and texture generation. We report visual and quantitative evaluation results across three dimensions: generated textured mesh, bare mesh, and texture map. We also provided user study results on 300 test cases involving 50 participants. The comparison shows the superiority of Hunyuan3D 2.0 in alignment between conditional images and generated meshes, generation of fine-grained details, and human preference ratings.
quotes: Our texture generation model – Hunyuan3D-Paint is made of a novel mesh-conditioned multi-view generation pipeline and a number of sophisticated techniques for preprocessing and baking multi-view images into high-resolution texture maps.

messages.text: 好，你刚才把原文和你的解释分开了，这点很清楚。那我想问一个和我研究直接相关的问题：这套流程里，哪一个环节对公开网络照片最脆弱？我的照片可能光照杂乱、有遮挡、背景复杂、分辨率也低。你觉得是去光照预处理、多视角生成，还是烘焙那一步最容易出问题？论文里有没有相关的说法，还是你的推测？

messages.short_answer: 就论文原文而言，只有光照/阴影被明确当作风险来处理：作者用去光照模块应对参考图的光照与阴影。遮挡、复杂背景和低分辨率在检索到的段落中没有找到相关说法，所以无法确认论文如何处理这些情况。哪一环最脆弱属于我的推测：我会优先怀疑去光照预处理，以及上游由图像生成裸网格的步骤，因为纹理阶段依赖这些前置结果。

sections.title: 论文明确处理的环节：光照与阴影
sections.text: 论文指出参考图通常带有明显且多样的光照和阴影，若直接输入多视角生成框架，光照和阴影可能被烘焙进纹理图；因此作者在前处理阶段加入了去光照模块。这说明对你的杂乱光照照片，去光照环节是原文直接点名的薄弱点。

sections.title: 上游误差可能向下游传递（我的推断）
sections.text: 论文描述的流程是先由 Hunyuan3D-DiT 根据输入图生成裸网格，再由 Hunyuan3D-Paint 利用几何先验和输入图生成纹理。因此如果遮挡或复杂背景导致裸网格形状出错，纹理阶段拿到的几何条件也会带着同样的错误，我的推断是纹理阶段很难纠正形状问题。这一点是我根据流程结构的推测，原文段落没有讨论这种失败情况。

retrieved.text: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation “Living out everyone’s imagination on creating and manipulating 3D assets.” —Hunyuan3D Team ∗ Abstract We present Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced large-scale 3D synthesis system for generating high-resolution textured 3D assets. This system includes two foundation components: a large-scale shape generation model – Hunyuan3D-DiT, and a largescale texture synthesis model – Hunyuan3D-Paint. The shape generative model, built on a scalable flow-based diffusion transformer, aims to create geometry that properly aligns with a given condition image, laying a solid foundation for downstream applications. The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes. Furthermore, we build Hunyuan3D-Studio – a versatile, user-friendly production platform that simplifies the re-creation process of 3D assets. It allows both professional and amateur users to manipulate or even animate their meshes efficiently.

To this end, we presentHunyuan3D 2.0, a 3D asset creation system with two strong open-sourced 3D foundation models:Hunyuan3D-DiTfor generative shape creation andHunyuan3D-Paintfor generative texture synthesis. Hunyuan3D 2.0 features a two-stage generation pipeline, starting with the creation of a bare mesh, followed by the synthesis of a texture map for that mesh. This strategy is effective for decoupling the difficulties of shape and texture generation [ 34, 107, 46, 47] and also provides flexibility for texturing either generated or handcrafted meshes. With this architecture, our shape creation model – Hunyuan3D-DiT, is designed as a large-scale flow-based diffusion model. As a prerequisite, we first train an autoencoder – Hunyuan3D-ShapeV AE using advanced techniques such as mesh surface importance sampling and variational token length to capture fine-grained details on the meshes. Then, we build up a dual-single stream transformer [ 45] on the latent space of our V AE with the flow-matching [53, 24] objective.

8 Conclusion In this report, we introduce an open-source 3D creation system—Hunyuan3D 2.0 —for generating textured meshes from images. We present Hunyuan3D-ShapeV AE, which is trained using a novel importance sampling method. This approach compresses each 3D object into a few latent tokens while minimizing reconstruction losses. Building on our V AE, we developed Hunyuan3D-DiT, an advanced diffusion transformer capable of generating visually appealing shapes that align precisely with input images. Besides, we introduce Hunyuan3D-Paint, another diffusion model designed to create textures for both our generated meshes and user-crafted meshes. With several innovative designs, our texture generation model, in conjunction with our shape generation model, can produce high-resolution, high-fidelity textured 3D assets from a single image. As we continue to make progress, we hope that Hunyuan3D 2.0 will serve as a robust baseline for large-scale 3D foundation models within the open-source community and facilitate future research endeavors.

sources.text: These pages describe the Hunyuan3D-DiT shape generation transformer, which uses double- and single-stream blocks to let shape latent tokens and image condition tokens interact, with timestep-only modulation and no positional embedding on the latent sequence. Image conditioning uses DINOv2 Giant features at 518x518 with background removal and centering, and training follows a flow matching objective with an affine conditional optimal transport path and Euler ODE sampling at inference. The pages then introduce Hunyuan3D-Paint, a generative texture map synthesis pipeline with image delighting as pre-processing, a reference-net and multi-task attention for multi-view consistency, and a geometry-aware greedy viewpoint selection strategy using 8 to 12 views. Details of the multi-view synthesis and texture baking stages are only referenced, not fully described on these pages.

These pages describe the geometry and view conditioning of the Hunyuan3D-Paint texture synthesis pipeline, where canonical normal maps and canonical coordinate maps are encoded by a pre-trained VAE and concatenated with latent noise, and a learnable view embedding is added. They then cover texture baking, including a view dropout strategy that samples 6 of 44 pre-set viewpoints to enable dense-view inference, a pre-trained single-image super-resolution step applied per view, and a weighted-sum inpainting method for uncovered UV texels. The final section gives implementation details: training from the Stable Diffusion 2 v-model checkpoint on a self-collected 3D dataset under even white light, 512x512 resolution, 80,000 steps, batch size 48, and learning rate 5e-5. The pages close by noting the framework also supports text- or image-guided texture generation for arbitrary geometry.

These pages describe the Hunyuan3D-Studio platform, a toolset for the 3D production pipeline built on Hunyuan3D 2.0, aimed at both experts and novices. They cover three features: Sketch-to-3D, which converts sketches into detailed images and then into high-fidelity textured 3D assets, and Low-polygon Stylization, which reduces dense generated meshes to low-polygon meshes. The low-polygon module uses a traditional vertex-merging geometric method and then transfers texture via a KD-tree nearest-neighbour lookup and texture baking. The section also introduces a 3D character animation function that uses a Graph Neural Network to predict skeleton keypoints and skinning weights, followed by motion templates; the text is cut off before that section concludes. No quantitative results or limitations are stated on these pages.

sections.text: 论文说纹理部分采用三阶段框架：预处理（输入图像去光照）、多视角图像合成（即 Hunyuan3D-Paint），以及基于密集多视角推理的纹理烘焙。论文还称 Hunyuan3D-Paint 是一个以网格为条件的多视角生成流程，加上预处理和把多视角图像烘焙为高分辨率纹理图的技术。

sections.title: 法线图与位置图是什么（通俗解释）
sections.text: 法线图记录网格表面每个点的朝向，位置图记录每个点在三维空间中的坐标。两者都由已生成的裸网格导出，因此可以告诉多视角生成模型物体的几何形状和视角下的可见结构，从而让纹理贴合形状。这是对一般概念的解释，并非论文原文。

persona_text:
# Persona: Sam

**Who.** Sam is a non-native-English-speaking PhD student in computer vision. He reads academic English but
prefers concise Chinese explanations that keep the English terminology (e.g. "diffusion model", "VAE",
"multi-view").

**What he wants.** To decide whether ideas or methods from a paper can inform his own research:
generating AR-ready 3D assets from photos that are publicly available on the web. Reading goal:
*Explore potential use in my research*.

**How he behaves.**
- Writes in Simplified Chinese mixed with English technical terms. Interface language: 中文（简体）.
- Sets a specific goal, begins with an overview, then asks focused questions about how the paper's key
  components connect, and about its logic, novelty, assumptions and limitations.
- Uses short references to earlier answers ("那第二个阶段呢", "this part", "你刚才说的那个").
- Challenges answers that sound vague or too confident ("论文里真的这么说吗？还是你推测的？").
- Checks the source selectively, mainly for numbers and claims that matter to his study.
- Relates the paper to his own setting: unconstrained web photos (varying lighting, occlusion, background,
  low resolution) and AR constraints (mesh size, PBR textures, real-time rendering).
- Expects a critical reading partner, not a summariser, examiner or unquestioning assistant.

**Paper.** Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
(arXiv 2501.12202).

log.learner_message: 你好，我想先对这篇论文有个整体了解。Hunyuan3D 2.0 到底提出了什么？请重点讲一下和我的目标相关的部分：我想从网上的公开照片生成可以用于 AR 的 3D assets，所以麻烦你从这个角度概括一下它的核心方法和输出结果。

log.instruction: Refer back with a short reference to the second component/stage PaperLens mentioned and ask how it works.
log.learner_message: 那第二个阶段呢？Hunyuan3D-Paint 是怎么根据你刚才说的法线图和位置图去生成纹理的？

log.instruction: Challenge one specific claim in the last answer: ask whether the paper really says this or whether PaperLens is inferring it.
log.learner_message: 等一下，你刚才说"法线图记录朝向、位置图记录坐标，所以纹理能贴合形状"这个部分，论文里真的这么说吗？还是你自己的推测？我想知道哪些是原文，哪些是你的解释。

log.instruction: Ask which part of the pipeline would be most fragile for your setting (unconstrained web photos).
log.learner_message: 好，你刚才把原文和你的解释分开了，这点很清楚。那我想问一个和我研究直接相关的问题：这套流程里，哪一个环节对公开网络照片最脆弱？我的照片可能光照杂乱、有遮挡、背景复杂、分辨率也低。你觉得是去光照预处理、多视角生成，还是烘焙那一步最容易出问题？论文里有没有相关的说法，还是你的推测？

log.instruction: Choose the verdict you find most reasonable after the review, with your own reason.
log.rationale: 两阶段设计和去光照预处理对我的网络照片管线有参考价值，但论文没有在低分辨率、遮挡、复杂背景的真实照片上验证，评估场景也不是AR需求。PaperLens给的依据大多是作者自己设定下的结果，所以我现在还不能直接采用，需要在自己的数据上先测试。
